Learn Photopea by making something in every lesson. Adobe Photoshop and GIMP can do similar work, but Photopea is the browser-based class workflow.

## Start here: Photopea beginner crash course

Watch the beginner video before you start **Build the Nameplate Text**. Keep Photopea open beside the video, pause often, and copy the actions so you learn where the main tools are.

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6dwSRbkSuq8 >}}

## Part 1: Guided name + logo name tag

Complete the lessons below in order. The first lessons are worked examples. The final lesson asks you to replace the example with **your own name, your own logo, and your own layout**.

{{< include ../../includes/generated/design-fabrication-logo-design-toc.md >}}

### What to submit for Part 1

Submit these three versions of your original name-tag design:

- `studentnumber-lastname-name-tag-master.psd`: editable master with clearly named layers;
- `studentnumber-lastname-name-tag.png`: transparent preview; and
- `studentnumber-lastname-name-tag.svg`: vector version with the logo and name visible.

Use the [Design Your Own Name + Logo Name Tag](../03-laser-cutting/01-name-logo.qmd) page for the planning sketches, file checks, reflection, and complete submission checklist.

## Part 2: Open-ended personal-brand graphic

After Part 1, use the same Photopea skills to make a banner, thumbnail, logo, or another screen graphic for an audience and three emotions. This project is open ended: use a tutorial for techniques, then change the words, images, colours, type, and layout so the finished work is yours.

[Open Part 2: Personal Brand Graphic](personal-brand-graphic-photopea.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

Choose one short tutorial as a starting point:

- [Gaming or Roblox character logo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mchoizRTY-s): notice how a rough character idea becomes a compact mark.
- [Apex Legends thumbnail](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t9V6Wp_OnQk): watch how contrast and hierarchy make one idea visible quickly.
- [Make a YouTube logo in under five minutes](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QmB14oyGWcw): make a simple mark, then revise it with the accessibility checks.

### What to submit for Part 2

- `studentnumber-lastname-personal-brand.psd`;
- `studentnumber-lastname-personal-brand.png`;
- your audience and three emotions;
- the feedback you received and the revision you made; and
- a short reflection explaining which design choice best communicates your personal brand.
